name: SiteGPT
description: SiteGPT builds AI customer-support chatbots trained on your website. This connector links your AI assistant to your SiteGPT account over MCP with browser OAuth — no API keys. Three compact tools cover the whole platform: `search` finds the right operation in the API catalog, `execute_read` fetches data (chatbots, conversations, leads, analytics), and `execute_write` makes changes (create chatbots, add knowledge, update prompts and settings) — reads run without interruption, writes always confirm first. Everything is bounded by the OAuth grant you approve: your role, your token scopes, your chatbot restrictions.

_published_faq.name: How do I add SiteGPT to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SiteGPT to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://sitegpt.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SiteGPT MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SiteGPT provides these MCP tools: execute_read, execute_write, and search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SiteGPT?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to SiteGPT in customer-support on the Manufact MCP catalog include Assembled, Brainfish, ClearFeed, Conduit, and DevRev.
SiteGPT requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SiteGPT is developed by SiteGPT. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
